caption: The drawing depicts a pale, intricately cut paper ornament with symmetrical, decorative patterns resembling leaves and floral motifs, draped over a vertically positioned yellow object. The paper is mostly white or light gray, with sharp, jagged edges forming a lace-like structure, and small circular and triangular holes throughout the design, allowing the yellow surface underneath to show through in various places. The yellow object beneath appears to be cylindrical and shiny, suggesting a metallic or glass surface. This composition is centered on a blank, slightly textured beige background, and the drawing is rendered with soft shadows and fine details to emphasize the delicate nature of the cut paper.
title: Drapery for Candlestick
